title_zh: 大慧普覺禪師 正法眼藏
title_pinyin: Dàhuì Pǔjué Chánshī Zhèng Fǎyǎn Zàng
title_en: Treasury of the Eye of the True Dharma (Dahui's Shobogenzo)
author_zh: 宋 涇縣雙徑山 大慧宗杲 禪師 輯
author_en: Compiled by Chan Master Dahui Zonggao (1089–1163 CE)
genre: Universal Anthology of Chan Transmission (正法眼藏)
overview: The original monumental Chinese 'Treasury of the Eye of the True Dharma' (Shōbōgenzō / 正法眼藏), comprising six fascicles and 661 core encounter records compiled by Master Dahui Zonggao to protect the living spirit of Chan from literalist degeneration.

sections.title_en: Qianfeng's One Road and Yunmen's Fan

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 越州乾峰和尚因僧問：「十方薄伽梵，一路涅槃門。未審路頭在甚麼處？」乾峰拈起拄杖，畫一畫云：「在者裏。」
dialogue.pinyin: Yuèzhōu Qiānfēng héshang yīn sēng wèn: 'Shífāng pójīafàn, yī lù nièpán mén. Wèi shěn lùtóu zài shènme chù?' Qiānfēng niān qǐ zhǔzhàng, huà yī huà yún: 'Zài zhèlǐ.'

translations.cleary: A monk asked Master Qianfeng, 'The World-Honored Ones of the ten directions have a single road to the gate of Nirvana. Where does that road begin?' Qianfeng took his staff, drew a line in the air, and said, 'Right here.'
translations.red_pine: A monk asked Master Qianfeng: 'The Bhagavans of the ten directions have one single road to the gate of Nirvana. Where is the road's beginning?' Qianfeng raised his staff, drew a line, and said: 'Right here.'
translations.sasaki: A monk asked Qianfeng: 'All Buddhas of the ten directions have but one road to Nirvana. Where does this road start?' Qianfeng drew a line with his staff: 'Here!'

dialogue.speaker: Yunmen / 雲門
dialogue.zh: 僧後請益雲門。門拈起扇子云：「扇子𨁝跳，上三十三天，築著帝釋鼻孔；東海鯉魚打一棒，雨似盆傾。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng hòu qǐngyì Yúnmén. Mén niān qǐ shànzi yún: 'Shànzi tiàotiào, shàng sānshísāntiān, zhùzháo Dìshì bíkǒng; dōnghǎi lǐyú dǎ yī bàng, yǔ sì pén qīng.'

translations.cleary: The monk later asked Yunmen for instruction on this. Yunmen held up his fan and said, 'This fan leaps up into the thirty-third heaven and hits the nostril of Indra; the carp of the Eastern Sea strikes a blow, and rain pours down like a tilted basin!'
translations.red_pine: The monk later asked Yunmen. Yunmen held up a fan and said: 'This fan jumps up to the thirty-third heaven and pokes Indra in the nostril; the carp of the Eastern Sea gets hit once with a staff, and rain pours down in buckets!'
translations.sasaki: The monk asked Yunmen. Ummon held up a fan: 'This fan leaps into the highest heaven, punching the god Indra in the nose; the carp of the Eastern Sea is struck, and the rains pour down!'

sections.title_zh: 正法眼藏何所指？鐵饅頭無下口處
sections.title_pinyin: Zhèng Fǎyǎn Zàng Hé Suǒ Zhǐ? Tiě Mántou Wú Xiàkǒu Chù
sections.title_en: What is the Treasury of the True Dharma Eye? The Iron Hammer Without Handle

dialogue.speaker: Dahui / 大慧宗杲
dialogue.zh: 正法眼藏，非名相，非修證，非文字。如大火聚，近之則燎卻面門；如鐵酸餡，咬著則崩卻牙齒。無可取，無可捨，是名如來妙心。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhèng fǎyǎn zàng, fēi míngxiàng, fēi xiūzhèng, fēi wénzì. Rú dà huǒ jù, jìn zhī zé liáo què miànmén; rú tiě suānxiàn, yǎo zháo zé bēng què yáchǐ. Wú kě qǔ, wú kě shě, shì míng rúlái miào xīn.

translations.cleary: The treasury of the eye of true teaching is not names or forms, not cultivation or attainment, not words and letters. It is like a great fire mass: approach it and your face is scorched; it is like an iron dumpling: bite into it and your teeth are shattered. Nothing to grasp, nothing to abandon: this is named the wondrous mind of the Realized One.
translations.red_pine: The treasury of the true Dharma eye is not names or concepts, not cultivation or realization, not words and letters. It is like a roaring mass of fire: come near and your face is scorched; like an iron dumpling: bite down and your teeth break. Nothing to take, nothing to throw away: this is called the wondrous mind of the Tathagata.
translations.sasaki: The Eye Treasury of the True Law is beyond words, beyond practice and attainment. Like a blazing fireball, to touch it is to be consumed; like an iron ball, it cannot be bitten into. Beyond grasping and rejecting, it is the mind of Suchness.
